title: The Exact Mahler Minimum in the Uniform Mod-Three Reciprocal Class
abstract: Among monic reciprocal integer polynomials of positive even degree, with constant coefficient 1, every inner coefficient congruent to 2 modulo 3, and no root of unity, the Mahler measure is minimized uniquely by x^4-x^3-x^2-x+1. Its measure lies strictly between 1.7220 and 1.7221; every other polynomial in this class has measure greater than 1.724. The result places no bound on degree, coefficient height, or reducibility and does not concern unrestricted Lehmer.
